insights.summary: The agent correctly identified the performance benefits of the requested optimization but failed due to environmental complexity. It became obsessed with reconciling the git history and the state of the files on disk, leading to a massive, non-compliant patch that included thousands of unrelated changes. It ultimately timed out while still exploring the git tree.
strengths: Strong ability to trace specific optimizations through git history.
weaknesses: Inability to ignore environmental noise (dirty git state).
Failure to use the provided editing tools.
